caption: The drawing depicts three ornate brass or gold-colored drawer handles and a decorative keyhole escutcheon, arranged in a vertical composition on a beige background. The handles, positioned at the top and bottom of the page, are shown in a frontal view and feature symmetrical, florally-embellished designs with curved edges and raised round terminals at each end. The pull handles are attached via two visible mounting posts. There are also two side views of the handles, placed to the right of the upper handle and to the left of the lower handle, each showing the thickness and rounded profile of the handles and their posts. In the center, a large decorative keyhole escutcheon is presented, similarly adorned with symmetrical swirling motifs and small floral patterns, with a central keyhole opening. The entire drawing is rendered with fine linework and soft shading, mostly in shades of yellow, gold, and brown, creating an illusion of shine and depth. A scale in inches is drawn at the lower left and the name "JANET RIZA" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Drawer Pulls
